# Checking OpenAI-hosted Default Skills

Custom Skills that users register in `environment.skills` are distinct from the default Skills included in the hosted image. CSV analysis falls within the scope of Spreadsheets, so references to that Skill may appear without separate registration.

On 2026-11-03, we confirmed `documents`, `Presentations`, and `Spreadsheets` in an actual environment created without any additional Skills, Plugins, or templates. We observed the same names and descriptions under `/opt/artifact-sdk/skills/{documents,presentations,spreadsheets}/SKILL.md` and `/root/.codex/skills/builtins/`. This list and these paths may vary by image and are not a fixed API contract.

## Registration Metadata

Check this before deleting the associated Session.

```python
environment = client.beta.agents.environments.retrieve(session.environment.id)
print([skill.to_dict() for skill in environment.skills])
```

The response measured in the default environment was `skills=[]`, but the default files above were present. Therefore, do not interpret this field as a complete list of default Skills. Chapter 9 uses this field to check the registered `csv-report`.

## Optional: Check the Actual File List

Sending the following request to an existing Session as a separate Turn may incur model and sandbox usage charges. It is not run automatically in the standard exercises.

```python
inventory_task = """Read-only inventory: run the following command in the sandbox,
then read only the name and description frontmatter of each SKILL.md.
Do not install packages, modify files, or perform any skill workflow.
find -L /opt/artifact-sdk/skills /root/.codex/skills/builtins -name SKILL.md -print
"""
with client.beta.agents.sessions.stream(session.id, input=inventory_task).with_result_collection() as stream:
    for event in stream:
        if event.type == "agent.session.turn.item.done" and event.item.type == "command_execution":
            print(event.item.exit_code, event.item.output)
    result = stream.get_final_result()
print(result.output_text)
```

The model stating that it “will use” a Skill, the presence of files, actually reading the instructions, and executing bundled scripts are each distinct forms of evidence. Check the execution process in Platform Trace, and distinguish it from the evidence file and script validation in Chapter 9.
